description: This file defines the RmiServiceEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine and handles remote method invocation via RMI for Apache OFBiz services. It manages remote dispatcher lookup and execution of services over RMI.

classes.name: RmiServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that extends GenericAsyncEngine to provide RMI-based remote service execution within Apache OFBiz.

methods.name: RmiServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the engine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously without returning a result.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the core logic of locating the remote dispatcher via RMI and invoking the service remotely, handling exceptions and returning the result map.
